item.title: The Exponential Time Hypothesis falls, twice in one day
item.description: OpenAI and Anthropic both claim machine-checked refutations of ETH. Also: Kakeya in every dimension, the AI-vs-lattices debate, an existence claim for QCD, and a peer-reviewed CO₂-to-fuel reaction map. Full text: https://wangbard.github.io/frontier_notes/issues/2026-10-27.html
